newsitem.title: CHINA: China Southern's HK IPO 2.44 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: China Southern's HK IPO 2.44 times subscribed.

text.p: China Southern Airlines Co Ltd said on Wednesday its Hong Kong initial public offering (IPO) was 2.44 times subscribed and the price fixed at HK$4.70 per H-share, at the top of a range.
China Southern offered 1.03 billion H-shares in a global flotation last week, of which 71 million H-shares were offered to the Hong Kong public.
The price range was HK$3.71 to HK$4.70 per share.
China Southern said it had received 10,350 valid applications from the Hong Kong public for 173.58 million shares.

"The directors further announce that indications of significant level of interest received from international investors for the 926,800,000 H-shares initially being offered under the U.S. and international offerings should result in all such H-shares being subscribed for in full," the company said.
The balance of the offering, 32.2 million shares, was placed to Goldman Sachs & Co.
Trading in the shares is due to begin on Thursday.
